subject: Keep the guard rails, retargeted at subjects
description: Three guards, ascending: WARN on a Heading 1 whose subject is unknown (this is the ONLY alarm for a renamed chapter -- the one case title-keying cannot self-heal); ABORT on two chapters resolving to one slug; and re-verify the existing 40%-of-document abort still fires (it caught the 2026-09-05 restyle that merged six chapters into the Abstract).
